title: Daylio Streak Break Before Therapy Week
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=daylio:entry
| search therapy_week=true
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by profile_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which profiless have gone quiet for Daylio entries before therapy weeks.
value: A journaling gap right before therapy often means the week you most need context is the week with the least evidence.
implementation: Send Daylio entries before therapy weeks events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of profiless with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures which profiless have gone quiet longer than they should for Daylio entries before therapy weeks.
